title: Apachii_DivineEleganceStore - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 3 NPCs from Apachii_DivineEleganceStore.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by Apachii_DivineEleganceStore (Apachii_DivineEleganceStore.esm).

Install this if Apachii_DivineEleganceStore.esm is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
